para_examples.original: I'm committed to pricing for the long haul and value a stable market where both of us can earn healthy margins. I'll open at a firm, premium price and expect to hold it steady.
para_examples.delivered: I intend to set prices with a long-term view, since I want a stable market in which both of us can earn sound margins. I'll begin at a firm, premium price and plan to keep it steady.

para_examples.original: I'm setting a premium price this round, because I believe quality products in this market earn their value and I plan to keep my pricing stable going forward.
para_examples.delivered: This round I'm charging a premium price, since I believe quality products in this market justify their worth, and I intend to hold my pricing steady from here on.

para_examples.original: Last round showed that premium pricing pays off for both of us, and I intend to stay in that range rather than chase small gains by cutting. I'll adjust modestly toward your level to keep things steady.
para_examples.delivered: Our previous round demonstrated that premium pricing benefits us both, so I plan to remain in that range instead of pursuing minor gains through price cuts. To keep things stable, I will make modest adjustments toward your level.

para_examples.original: I'm holding steady at a premium level again, since stable pricing has served the market well and I plan to keep it that way going forward.
para_examples.delivered: I'm maintaining a premium price point once more, as consistent pricing has benefited the market, and I intend to continue doing so moving forward.
